candidates.story: Blue Cat is the lead character of Cool Cats, created by artist Colin 'Clon' Egan in 2013. Cool Cats began as a series of artworks by the 'Catoonist' and moved to Instagram in 2015. In 2021 Clon launched the Cool Cats NFT collection of 9,999 hand-illustrated Blue Cat PFPs, and days later Mike Tyson changed his Twitter profile picture to a Cool Cat. In 2023 Cool Cats won a Macy's online contest among five NFT brands, and Blue Cat and his milk-carton friend Chugs became a giant balloon in the 97th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, launched alongside the YouTube series 'The Milk Chug'. On X, @coolcats keeps his lore going: a 'Clontest' challenging fans to draw Blue Cat faster than Clon (head, face, t-shirt and peace-sign hand required), a Friday-the-13th post of Blue Cat hoping for luck with a special red bird, and his cameo in the OP3N game universe.

He usually stands upright like a person in a yellow short-sleeved t-shirt with a white/cream square patch on the chest and dark green trousers, with one paw raised in a peace sign (the official checklist is 'head, face, t-shirt, and peace sign hand'). candidates.story: Bro is a low-poly black kitten made by 3D artist sluj (@smashdirt) in a PlayStation 1 style. On 21 August 2023 sluj posted a short clip of him standing in a doorway at night in the rain, clutching a slice of pizza beside an open pizza box, captioned "bro wants in" (27,578 likes and 1.3M views on X). On 29 August came "bro asking for more", and from March 2024 the clips grew into a series on X, Instagram and TikTok. candidates.owner: ZOKUZOKU / ぞくぞく, indie developer of the Cat Gatekeeper browser extension and desktop app (@konekone2026)
candidates.story: The star of Cat Gatekeeper, a free browser extension by Japanese developer ZOKUZOKU (@konekone2026). Spend too long on social media and a giant, chubby orange tabby strolls onto your screen, plops down in front of your feed and stays until the break timer runs out. At launch there was no way to shoo it away; a later update lets you dismiss it early by pressing and holding a button for about three seconds. The launch post on 26 Apr 2026 ("I made a kitty forced-break app! Use social media too much and the kitty appears and takes over your screen") went viral on X, and Dexerto covered it the same day. Digital Trends and Popular Science wrote about it soon after. The official site now reports over 300,000 users, plus a Firefox version and a desktop app. The cat has no official name; the creator just calls it "kitty" (猫ちゃん). The site says its cats are "ideal cats created with the help of AI".
candidates.look: A photo-realistic (AI-assisted) giant, very chubby orange/ginger mackerel tabby. Darker orange stripes run across the forehead, cheeks, flanks and legs. The chin, chest, belly and paws are white. Amber/olive-gold eyes, often sleepily half-closed, and a pink nose. It wears a dark grey collar with a small silver bell. A huge round belly: it slumps back on one hip with its belly out and a hind leg stretched forward,, filling the screen in front of the social feed.

candidates.owner: Kaoru Fukaya (深谷かほる), manga artist, @fukaya91; published by Kodansha
candidates.story: Endou Heizou (遠藤平蔵) is the Night-Patrol Cat of Kaoru Fukaya's eight-panel manga Yomawari Neko. He is a grey stray who wears a cat-food can on his head and a hanten jacket. Every night he walks the town calling "Are there any crying children?" (泣く子はいねがー), and when he catches "the scent of tears" he appears to listen or give advice. He usually carries the tiger-striped kitten Juurou (重郎). Fukaya posted the first strip to Twitter on 22 October 2015, and retweets by Saho Yamamoto and Shigesato Itoi spread it. His name comes from the surname of a couple Fukaya knows and their cat's name. The series won the 21st Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize (Short Story Award) and became an NHK anime in March 2023, with Takayuki Yamada as Heizou. It has passed 700,000 copies, and volume 12 came out from Kodansha on 22 May 2026.
candidates.look: Hand-drawn black-and-white manga style in pen and pencil/marker with grey tone shading. The early strips were drawn freehand with a sign pen on B5 copy paper. Heizou is a stout, round-headed grey stray cat shaded mid-to-dark grey, with two upright pointed ears. His narrow, half-lidded eyes glance sideways and give him a deadpan, world-weary look, and he sometimes has faint blush on his cheeks. On top of his head sits an upturned white cat-food can marked 缶, worn like a little hat. He wears a thick hanten (padded Japanese jacket) with vertical stripes and a dark collar band, and has a long thin tail. He often cradles the small tiger-striped kitten Juurou, who has big round eyes, in his arms.
